messages:
maya: quick idea  add a lightweight 'anchor' marker in the time range picker so folks can capture a deploy/event window and jump to it on the heatmap. helps compare p95 across identical windows.

leo: sounds useful. main UX questions: how obvious is creating an anchor, and do anchors persist by default?

maya: default session-scoped, with an explicit 'save comparison' option that creates a shareable link. create via keyboard (Enter) or via an inline + button in the picker.

sam: sampling note: our current per-bucket reservoir sampling introduces jitter in p95. if anchors snap to non-aligned buckets, charts can look like regressions. options: align buckets to anchors OR show a "sampled" badge with hover showing sample_rate and sampling_strategy.

tia: accessibility: anchor creation must be keyboard reachable and announced via aria-live: "Anchor created: <label>". anchor markers need >= 4.5:1 contrast against chart bg; also focus order: timepicker -> anchors list -> chart.

aria: microcopy suggestions: button "Create anchor" (not "Pin range"). sampled badge copy: "Sampled" with tooltip: "This view uses sampled data (%s). Click for full-scan options.". visual: slim vertical marker, darker-blue token (#083E86) for contrast.

leo: UI performance: when switching anchors, prefer streaming deltas (anchor_mode=stream) to avoid full re-query delays. fall back to full only when user requests an exact full-scan.

sam: we'll add sampling_rate + sampling_strategy to metrics. will also support anchor_mode flag on the API.

maya: next steps: aria + color pass (tia/aria) and a tiny copy/copy hover for the sampled badge. eng (sam) to confirm telemetry fields and streaming plan. schedule 15m sync if needed.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes: )
